Seven tasks completed.

Chromium completed all 20 on the frozen copies. Litebird completed 7, did not reach the requested section on 5, exited before producing a frame on 6, and lacked the input driver to test 2. No engine fixes included.

What this tells us

Typing, page JavaScript and an updated, readable result worked together on seven text tools. None looked like the reference throughout. On all five Python proposals the text piled up at the top; on all five Git manuals and Hextris the native process exited with SIGSEGV during navigation. The failing layer is not yet diagnosed.

Interpretation: 20 pages, five source trees, only four task families. This measures these jobs, not a percentage of the web. Compare the same tasks after each change.
